sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 734)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Ned Wever tracking chemical dart assassins on *Bulldog Drummond*, Elmer Davis and Edward R. Murrow breaking the historic US-British Destroyers-for-Bases naval pact on *CBS World News Today*, Canadian Mountie manhunts on *The Silver Eagle* for General Mills, Carmen Dragon and Rise Stevens performing in manufacturing plant drama on *The Prudential Family Hour of Stars*, British music hall comedy on *Two Daffodils*, and 1937 college gridiron season previews on WACO, Ned Wever (1944), Elmer Davis (1940), Jim Ameche (1952), Carmen Dragon (1949), and *Two Daffodils* (1934–1952):
